g.title: crate Arvane text: shaping, line breaking and cursor geometry over parley.
crate::build Construction of a parley layout from a paragraph and its spans.
crate::cache Everything a text engine computes from its fonts, replaced as a whole.
crate::layouts Cache of shaped paragraphs kept across calls and reused at every width.
crate::metrics Validates text metrics and resolves line heights.
crate::output Conversion of a line-broken layout into measured and drawable output.
crate::text_engine TextEngine: font registration, and cached measuring and shaping of text.
crate::transform Case conversion (CSS `text-transform`) applied before shaping.
